text: If I could give 10 stars, I would. This is probably the first clinic I've ever genuinely wanted to write a review for. Both the doctor and the staff are incredibly lovely and provide excellent service. They offer great consultations and don't push any sales pitches – and by "don't sell," I mean there's absolutely no hidden agenda. When I asked questions, the staff didn't pressure me into anything. If you want to get any treatments, you have to consult with the doctor first; there's no pressure to buy anything beforehand. I started by buying an underarm laser treatment course, and ended up getting Ultraformer, Botox for a facelift, mesofat, and most recently, Sculptra. The doctor's consultations were amazing; they were completely honest about what I should and shouldn't do. The doctor assessed my face and even advised me against rushing into treatments, unlike other places I've been to. It made going to the clinic feel less pressured and more enjoyable. I didn't feel intimidated by the pressure to buy anything. Regarding the equipment and medications, the doctor showed me everything before every treatment. The equipment is purchased directly from the company, has the clinic's name clearly displayed, and the number of shots is exactly as agreed. The medications are also opened in front of me, with matching serial numbers on the box and bottle. Even after several visits where I told the doctor not to explain anymore, she still repeated the explanations for my peace of mind. If you're looking for a clinic, I highly recommend Dr. Piew's clinic. 💖 This is a genuine customer review. Something I really want to share.
